summary: point_transform_native (avm2_display.c:3794-3825) computes localToGlobal/globalToLocal in unrounded doubles. Ruffle's Matrix*Point<Twips> rounds the f32 rotate/scale product half-to-even into an i32 twip BEFORE adding the integral translation; helper round_to_i32 already exists at :601. Fifth instance of ruffle-geometry-is-integer-twips; the 2026-07-30 fix reached mat_mul and rect_union_xform but not this function. Verified by hand: 200*a+400*c = 299.99999106 -> round 300 -> +800 twips = 55.0px == expected, vs our 54.999999552965164. Oracle-directional (Flash is integer twips too), so the precedent is zero regressions across 176 canaries. Canaries: tab_ordering_arrows, getbounds family, from_shumway/stroke1, localconnection.

Three gaps in the flash.geom builtin surface. (a) Transform.matrix/matrix3D duality: assigning .matrix must make .matrix3D return a promoted Matrix3D (rawData 2,3,0,0,4,5,0,0,0,0,1,0,6,7,0,1) and assigning .matrix3D must make .matrix null; we do the opposite and geom_transform dies on #1009 (accessing field: rawData) at expected line 24, cascading ~50 of its 53 missing lines. (b) flash.geom.Matrix.copyRowTo/copyColumnTo are never registered (avm2_display.c:14043 registers only the ...From halves) -> avm2/matrix #1006. (c) Transform.getRelativeMatrix3D missing -> TransformBasics #1006. NOTE: avm2/matrix will not flip on (b) alone; price it jointly with L1.
